tasks_completed.description: Added isSidechain forwarding in sessionScanner.ts sendExisting=false path
tasks_completed.changes: Added isJSONLOnlyMessage() helper that checks both isMeta and isSidechain flags. Used in markExistingAsProcessed() to forward JSONL-only messages during scanner initialization with sendExisting=false.
tasks_completed.rationale: SDK does not emit isSidechain messages via stdout. They are only in JSONL. Without forwarding them from the scanner, the file watcher never re-delivers them.

tasks_completed.description: Added sentSidechainUuids dedup Set to claudeRemoteLauncher.ts
tasks_completed.changes: Added sentSidechainUuids: Set<string> to LauncherState interface. Initialized in createLauncherState().
tasks_completed.rationale: Prevents duplicate sidechain messages when SDK emits some via stdout that are also in JSONL.

tasks_completed.description: Track sidechain UUIDs in onMessage callback after enqueue
tasks_completed.changes: Added trackSidechainUuid() function called in buildOnMessage after message enqueue. Records UUID of any message with isSidechain=true.
tasks_completed.rationale: Populates the dedup set so the JSONL scanner callback can skip already-sent sidechain messages.

tasks_completed.description: Extended meta-scanner callback to forward isSidechain messages with dedup
tasks_completed.changes: createScannerMessageHandler() now also forwards isSidechain=true messages after checking sentSidechainUuids to prevent duplicates.
tasks_completed.rationale: This is the core fix: sidechain messages from JSONL are now forwarded to the server via the same scanner mechanism used for isMeta messages.

tasks_completed.description: Removed fake Task sidechain root (convertSidechainUserMessage block)
tasks_completed.changes: Removed the entire block (previously lines 329-342) that called sdkToLogConverter.convertSidechainUserMessage() for Task tool_use blocks. This synthetic message is no longer needed.
tasks_completed.rationale: Real JSONL sidechain messages include the actual user message with isSidechain=true, making the synthetic root redundant and causing duplicates.

tasks_completed.description: Reset sentSidechainUuids in finally block between launches
tasks_completed.changes: Added state.sentSidechainUuids.clear() in cleanupAfterLaunch(), called from the finally block of each launch iteration.
tasks_completed.rationale: Prevents stale UUIDs from a previous Claude launch blocking legitimate sidechain messages in the next launch.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural gap, not a regression
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The original implementation only forwarded SDK stdout messages to the server. isMeta forwarding was added later but isSidechain was never included. The entire downstream pipeline was ready but received no data.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Extended the proven isMeta forwarding pattern to also handle isSidechain messages, with UUID-based deduplication to prevent duplicates if SDK ever starts emitting sidechain messages.
